Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 8,088.36 down -21.33 points August 30, 2018, 04:45:13 PM EDT By NASDAQ.com News Shutterstock photo
Thursday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 8,088.36. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 1.97 billion. Declining stocks led advancers by 1.35 to 1 ratio. There were 1280 advancers and 1727 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 61 stocks reached a 52 week high and 26 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed down -.23% for the day; a total of -17.51 points. The current value is 7,642.67. Dollar Tree, Inc. ( DLTR ) had the largest percent change down (-15.54%) while Micron Technology, Inc. ( MU ) had the largest percent change gain rising 1.79%. The Dow Jones index closed down -.53% for the day; a total of -137.65 points. The current value is 25,986.92. Caterpillar, Inc. ( CAT ) had the largest percent change down (-1.97%) while Apple Inc.
